description: Needs sign-in: Evaluate a sequence of LaTeX statements in order, in one shared scratch scope (over the definitions of the document named by documentId, if any), then discard the scope. A definition (a := 5, f(x) := x^2) is visible to later statements of the same call; nothing persists after the call and no document is changed. Use it for a multi-step calculation, or to verify candidate solutions (bind x := 2, then evaluate x^2 = 4). Evaluation stops at the first failing statement (stoppedAt is its 0-based index). Previous answers (\%) are not available; name intermediates with :=.

documentId.description: The id of a document (from list_documents or search_documents). With it, the expression sees that document's definitions; without it, an empty scope.

statements.description: LaTeX statements evaluated in order in one shared, discarded-at-return scope. Definitions bind for later statements in this call only.

name: evaluate_steps
title: Evaluate steps
